description: This file declares the 'backend_worker' class responsible for managing a background thread that processes log entries from a queue and dispatches them to sinks in the 'ocudulog' logging framework.

classes.name: backend_worker
classes.description: Manages a secondary thread that continuously processes log entries from a queue and dispatches them to registered sinks.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the backend worker thread with a specified priority.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the backend worker thread if it is running.

methods.name: is_running
methods.description: Returns whether the worker thread is currently active.

methods.name: set_error_handler
methods.description: Sets a custom error handler for error notifications; ignored if the worker is running.

methods.name: create_worker
methods.description: Initializes the worker thread with a given priority.

methods.name: do_work
methods.description: Main loop executed by the worker thread to process log entries.

methods.name: process_log_entry
methods.description: Handles individual log entries retrieved from the queue.

methods.name: process_outstanding_entries
methods.description: Processes remaining log entries until the queue is empty.

methods.name: report_queue_on_full_once
methods.description: Reports a warning if the queue is nearly full, only once per threshold breach.

methods.name: set_thread_priority
methods.description: Sets the thread priority for the worker thread.
